NOT WORTH THE MONEY - QUALITY DOWN
Feb 2023
Hoang Yen was a very good authentic Vietnamese restaurant. Now Feb 2023, quality of cooking is down. Portion sizes were not similar to before. May be the restaurant has new chefs; new chefs do not follow "family cooking" styles that the restaurant offered before.
I was a supporter of Hoang Yen for many years, but now I will not go there. I will try again few months later to see that they change back to the "family cooking" style or not.

Lack of management.
Mar 2019 • Business
Our company made reservation with Hoang Yen Buffet and got confirmed to celebrate International Woman Date (08/03/2019) but when we arrived, all table are still fully booked! So we asked the staff there and she said they did not received any information about our booking from their sale team! We tried to call the person in charge but the phone keep being busy and finally we talked to that person and let that person spoke to the lady there and thanks god, the lady finally went to look for us a table! However, we had to wait for 45 minutes before we got any table available! It is unacceptable! The foods were average but the staff at the area was very helpful and friendly. The reason I gave 2/5 is for the bad management they had.

Awful, overpriced....SKIP
Jul 2017
Three of us who love almost any kind of food, but especially ASIAN food (my wife is Chinese) came here with great expectations. We paid about $22USD/each for the buffet. It looked very good. The food was in general COLD and flavorless. What a shock. To the restaurant's defense, the patrons would not keep the lids closed on the hot serving dishes...so no wonder the food was cold. But if that is the type of patron, this is not a place I want to pay a premium price for cold food. The lack of hot vegetables was notable. There was a salad area...but we avoid salads while traveling overseas. There table service for drinks was poor....the overall value was also very poor. There are just too many great places to eat in Saigon to waste your time, money and stomach coming here. I would give a zero star if available.
